# The 1962 amalgamation of Hubballi and Dharwad

## One corporation for both cities

The Dharwad district profile says the towns of Dharwad and Hubli were amalgamated in 1962 to constitute the Hubli Dharwad Municipal Corporation. The current archive uses Hubballi, the spelling used on the corporation's [contact page](http://www.hdmc.mrc.gov.in/en/contact-us). The Local Government Directory lists one corporation, Hubballi-Dharwad, at local body code **251893**. Dharwad district and the municipal corporation are different jurisdictions. The district history gives the year of merger, but does not reproduce the formation order or its boundary schedule.

## Corporation office

The corporation gives its address as Sir Siddappa Kambali Road, Hubballi 580020, and lists `commissioner.hdmc@gmail.com`. The [district public utility entry](https://dharwad.nic.in/en/public-utility/hubli-dharwad-municipal-corporation/) lists the office telephone as 0836-2213800. Its dedicated PIN field agrees with the municipality's 580020, although the free-text address in the same district entry ends in 580024.
